conventions.charts: Same charts as config/muscle_map.json. torso_front/torso_back/torso_back_top: [u, v] = [|x| in metres from the midline, height z in metres]. torso_around: [angle_deg around the trunk (0 = front, 90 = side, 180 = back), z in metres]. Limb charts (shoulder/upperarm/lowerarm/thigh/calf): [s along the segment (0 = proximal joint, 1 = distal joint), angle_deg around the segment]. All charts describe the REST pose mirrored onto the left side, exactly like the muscle map.
conventions.fan: Fibres converge on one insertion point: 'center' is the insertion in chart coordinates, 'cut_deg' is a ray direction (degrees in the metric chart plane, 0 = +u) that must NOT cross the muscle — the striation phase wraps there. 'angular_spacing_deg' is the angle between neighbouring striations as seen from the center. Striations are radial lines out of the center, so fibres visibly converge on the insertion.
conventions.limb_charts: 'angle_center' is the reference angle the chart is unwrapped around (the patch angle of the group); 'radius_m' turns degrees around the limb into arc metres. Both are per-group because the same chart serves several groups.
conventions.limits: One field per group: multi-headed muscles (triceps, biceps, quadriceps, hamstrings) are drawn as one converging/parallel field, not per-head fields. The pectoralis and latissimus tendon twist near the insertion is NOT modelled — the twist happens in the tendon, outside the muscle belly shown. Pennation angle is NOT modelled: striations follow the belly's mean fibre direction.
conventions.parallel: Fibres run parallel to 'axis' (a unit vector in METRIC chart coordinates: metres along u, arc metres along v). 'spacing_m' is the distance between neighbouring striations across the fibres. 'origin_point' is an arbitrary phase reference in metric coordinates. 'wrap': true quantises the spacing so a whole number of striations fits around the limb (no seam where the angle wraps).

adductors.label: Hip adductors
adductors.note: Parallel along the thigh; the slight inferolateral slant of the adductor mass is not drawn separately.

biceps_brachii.label: Biceps brachii
biceps_brachii.note: Parallel along the arm toward the elbow; the two heads share one field.
biceps_brachii.origin: Long head: supraglenoid tubercle of the scapula. Short head: coracoid process.

calves.label: Gastrocnemius and soleus
calves.note: Parallel along the calf toward the heel; the two muscles share one field.
calves.origin: Gastrocnemius: medial/lateral femoral condyles. Soleus: soleal line of the tibia and fibula.

deltoid_anterior.label: Deltoid, anterior head
deltoid_anterior.note: Fan centre at the tuberosity, just past the far/lateral corner of the region, so fibres converge down/outward from the clavicle.

deltoid_lateral.label: Deltoid, lateral head
deltoid_lateral.note: Parallel along the arm: as seen from the tuberosity this long, narrow head subtends too small an angle for a fan (striations would alias near the insertion). The slight convergence is sacrificed for a readable field.

deltoid_posterior.label: Deltoid, posterior head
deltoid_posterior.note: Fan centre at the tuberosity (lateral humerus), seen from the posterior region.

erector_spinae.insertion: Ribs and vertebral processes up to the skull.
erector_spinae.label: Erector spinae
erector_spinae.origin: Sacrum, iliac crest, spinous processes (common tendon).

forearm_muscles.label: Forearm flexors and extensors
forearm_muscles.note: One merged region wrapping the whole forearm, drawn as fibres along the arm. Flexor/extensor directions differ in reality; this is a deliberate simplification, and 'wrap' keeps the field seamless around the limb.
forearm_muscles.origin: Flexors: medial epicondyle and forearm bones. Extensors: lateral epicondyle and forearm bones.

gluteus_maximus.insertion: Iliotibial band (~75% of fibres) and gluteal tuberosity of the femur. Fibres run inferolateral at 32-45 degrees.
gluteus_maximus.label: Gluteus maximus
gluteus_maximus.note: Fan centre lateral/inferior, at the IT-band/gluteal-tuberosity insertion zone.
gluteus_maximus.origin: Posterior ilium, sacrum, coccyx, sacrotuberous ligament, thoracolumbar fascia.

gluteus_medius.insertion: Lateral surface of the greater trochanter of the femur.
gluteus_medius.label: Gluteus medius
gluteus_medius.note: Fan converging down onto the greater trochanter.
gluteus_medius.origin: Outer surface of the ilium between the anterior and posterior gluteal lines.

hamstrings.insertion: Head of the fibula and lateral tibial condyle (biceps femoris); medial tibia (semitendinosus, semimembranosus).
hamstrings.label: Hamstrings
hamstrings.note: Parallel along the back of the thigh toward the knee; medial/lateral heads share one field.
hamstrings.origin: Ischial tuberosity (biceps femoris long head, semitendinosus, semimembranosus); linea aspera (biceps femoris short head).

latissimus_dorsi.insertion: Floor of the intertubercular groove of the humerus. Upper fibres horizontal, middle oblique upward, lower vertical upward, all converging on the humerus.
latissimus_dorsi.label: Latissimus dorsi
latissimus_dorsi.note: Fan centre at the humerus, just anterior to the region, so the whole back fans toward the armpit. The tendon twist is not modelled.
latissimus_dorsi.origin: Spinous processes T7-L5, thoracolumbar fascia, iliac crest, lower 3-4 ribs, inferior angle of the scapula.

obliques.insertion: Linea alba, pubic tubercle, anterior half of the iliac crest.
obliques.label: External obliques
obliques.note: Fibres run superolateral to inferomedial ('hands in pockets'): in (arc, z) coordinates the axis points toward the front and down.

pectoralis_major.insertion: Lateral lip of the intertubercular (bicipital) groove of the humerus. Clavicular fibres run down/lateral, middle fibres horizontal, lower fibres up/lateral.
pectoralis_major.label: Pectoralis major
pectoralis_major.note: Fan centre sits just lateral to the region, at the humerus, so striations converge on the insertion and fan out toward the sternum/clavicle. The tendon twist is not modelled.
pectoralis_major.origin: Medial half of the clavicle (clavicular head); sternum and superior six costal cartilages (sternocostal head); aponeurosis of the external oblique (abdominal fibres).

quadriceps.label: Quadriceps femoris
quadriceps.note: Parallel along the thigh toward the knee; the four heads share one field (the vastus medialis oblique pull is not drawn separately).
quadriceps.origin: Rectus femoris: anterior inferior iliac spine. Vasti: femoral shaft.

rectus_abdominis.label: Rectus abdominis
rectus_abdominis.note: Vertical fibres. The horizontal tendinous intersections ('six-pack' lines) are not fibres and are not drawn.

rotator_cuff_posterior.insertion: Greater tubercle of the humerus (middle/lower facets).
rotator_cuff_posterior.label: Infraspinatus and teres minor
rotator_cuff_posterior.note: Small fan converging laterally on the greater tubercle.
rotator_cuff_posterior.origin: Infraspinous fossa of the scapula (infraspinatus); upper lateral border of the scapula (teres minor).

serratus_anterior.insertion: Medial border of the scapula (costal surface).
serratus_anterior.label: Serratus anterior
serratus_anterior.note: Fibres run from the ribs back/up toward the scapula; the scapular attachment is far from this region, so the field is near-parallel here rather than a fan.
serratus_anterior.origin: Outer surfaces of the upper 8-9 ribs.

tibialis_anterior.insertion: Medial cuneiform and base of the first metatarsal.
tibialis_anterior.label: Tibialis anterior
tibialis_anterior.note: Parallel along the front of the shin toward the ankle.
tibialis_anterior.origin: Lateral condyle and upper lateral surface of the tibia, interosseous membrane.

trapezius.insertion: Lateral third of the clavicle (superior fibres), acromion and scapular spine (middle/inferior fibres).
trapezius.label: Trapezius
trapezius.note: One fan centred at the acromion: upper fibres run down/lateral, middle horizontal, lower up/lateral — the classic trapezius fan. The centre sits just lateral to the region.
trapezius.origin: External occipital protuberance, superior nuchal line, ligamentum nuchae, spinous processes C7-T12.

triceps_brachii.label: Triceps brachii
triceps_brachii.note: Parallel along the arm: all three heads run toward the olecranon and the belly is long and narrow, so a fan would alias near the elbow. Per-head fields are not drawn.
triceps_brachii.origin: Long head: infraglenoid tubercle of the scapula. Lateral head: posterior humerus above the radial groove. Medial head: posterior humerus below the radial groove.

references.cite: Gray, H. (1918). Anatomy of the Human Body. Public domain. Muscle descriptions: pectoralis major (clavicular fibres downward/lateral, middle horizontal, lower upward/lateral, converging on the lateral lip of the bicipital groove); trapezius (superior fibres downward/lateral, middle horizontal, inferior upward/lateral, converging on clavicle/acromion/scapular spine); latissimus dorsi (upper horizontal, middle oblique upward, lower vertical upward, converging on the floor of the intertubercular groove); deltoid (converging on the deltoid tuberosity).
references.used_for: Fan geometry of pectoralis major, trapezius, latissimus dorsi, deltoid.

references.cite: Geeky Medics. Superficial Back Muscles. https://geekymedics.com/superficial-back-muscles/ (accessed 13/11/2026). Trapezius fibres converge on clavicle/acromion/scapular spine; latissimus dorsi fibres converge onto a single common tendon.

Standard origin/insertion tables, cross-checked 13/11/2026 (e.g. https://www.teamlabbody.com/en/anatomy/muscles/ and https://humanome.co/charts/arm-muscles-chart-d216d0a4c4.pdf). Triceps brachii: long head infraglenoid tubercle, lateral/medial heads posterior humerus, all to the olecranon. Biceps brachii: long head supraglenoid tubercle, short head coracoid process, to the radial tuberosity.
references.used_for: Triceps/biceps parallel fields (fibres run along the arm toward the elbow). Facts only; no content copied.

references.cite: Precision Clinical Education. External Oblique (fibres superolateral to inferomedial, 'hands in pockets') and Gluteus Maximus (fibres inferolateral at 32-45 deg to the iliotibial band and gluteal tuberosity). https://www.precisionclinicaleducation.com/anatomy/muscles/external-oblique-4251 and .../gluteus-maximus-8332 (accessed 13/11/2026).
references.used_for: Obliques diagonal field; gluteus maximus fan centre (lateral/inferior insertion).

No geometry was downloaded, traced or derived. See docs/exercise-visual-system/OPEN_SOURCE_AUDIT.md.

See OPEN_SOURCE_AUDIT.md.
references.used_for: Nothing. Recorded so the check is not repeated.

review: Fibre directions were placed by the pipeline author from textbook origin/insertion anatomy (see references). They describe the direction of the surface striations only; they are NOT measured fibre data, NOT a dissection, and an anatomist or qualified coach has NOT reviewed them. The muscle regions themselves (config/muscle_map.json) are untouched by this file.
